findings.description: F001 still contains stale substrate-posture wording saying the same unproven consumer gap on a substrate plan warns, while the contract and later D030 text require any consumer-journey-bearing plan, including substrate, to block unless structurally deferred or dispositioned.
findings.recommendation: Remove or narrow the stale substrate warning language so advisory is only the substrate opted-in/no-consumer-journey cell.

findings.description: The delivery_class parser is specified only for valid enum values and absent metadata. An invalid frontmatter value is not pinned, so a typo could be treated like absent/substrate and weaken the product_metadata activation path.
findings.recommendation: Define invalid delivery_class handling deterministically, preferably fail-closed or emit a blocking/explicit validation finding, and add a parser test.

findings.description: The contract requires posture-matrix evidence, but F001 lists scenario tests rather than a complete matrix over opt_in, has_consumer_journey, product-class goal_type, and product_metadata.
findings.recommendation: Add a table-driven test for experience_readiness_active and enforcement_posture covering all deterministic trigger/posture cells.

findings.description: The real execution requirement is per objective claim per declared consumer, but the proposed tests do not pin objective-keyed grouping or prevent one real execution from satisfying multiple journeys that share a data_source.
findings.recommendation: Add a close-gate test with two objective journeys sharing a data_source where only one has a real execution; the uncovered journey must remain unproven.

findings.description: F001 records consumer_outcome_pending as structured advisory state, but it does not pin the taxonomy/output shape the way it does for consumer_outcome_unproven and no_consumer_journey_declared.
findings.recommendation: Register consumer_outcome_pending with advisory severity and a deterministic finding shape, then assert that shape in the pending human not_yet_typed test.
